title: The Cover of Kowloon Revisited
author: Lena Blackwood
blurb: Felix Quintana, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
